method_card.title: Holidays and Travel Plans
method_card.content:
This lesson covers holiday destinations, countries and how to talk about travel plans using the near future tense (ir a + infinitive) and the conditional (me gustaría + infinitive).

SpanishEnglish
las vacacionesthe holidays
ir de vacacionesto go on holiday
viajarto travel
el viajethe journey / trip
la playathe beach
las montañasthe mountains
el campothe countryside
el extranjeroabroad
el verano pasadolast summer
el año que vienenext year
me encantóI loved it
me lo pasé bienI had a good time
me gustaríaI would like
voy a + infinitiveI am going to…
sería emocionanteit would be exciting

Grammar focus — near future and conditional: Use ir a + infinitive for plans you have already made: voy a ir a España (I am going to go to Spain). Use me gustaría + infinitive for wishes: me gustaría visitar México (I would like to visit Mexico). Use sería + adjective for hypotheticals: sería relajante (it would be relaxing). Note the preposition: ir a Francia (to France — motion), estar en Francia (in France — location).

Model paragraph: Este verano voy a ir de vacaciones a Italia con mi familia. Me gustaría visitar Roma porque sería muy interesante. El año pasado fui a la playa y me lo pasé muy bien. (This summer I am going to go on holiday to Italy with my family. I would like to visit Rome because it would be very interesting. Last year I went to the beach and I had a great time.)
steps: Learn the key holiday destination vocabulary and countries
Master ir a + infinitive for plans and me gustaría for wishes
Practise using sería + adjective to justify a choice
Build sentences combining past (fui, me encantó) and future tenses

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — holiday plans appear in every exam series

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'El verano pasado fui de vacaciones a España con mi familia y me encantó.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Break the sentence into chunks: El verano pasado = last summer | fui de vacaciones = I went on holiday | a España = to Spain.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Con mi familia = with my family. Me encantó = I loved it (preterite of encantar — a completed reaction).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Last summer I went on holiday to Spain with my family and I loved it.

worked_examples.question: Which form is correct? 'El año que viene _____ (ir) a Italia.' — voy a ir, iré, or fue?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: El año que viene = next year. This is a future time reference, so we need a future form — not the preterite.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Fue is preterite (he/she/it went) — wrong tense and wrong person. Iré (simple future, Higher) works. Voy a ir (near future with ir a) is accessible to all students.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Voy a ir a Italia. (I am going to go to Italy.) Both voy a ir and iré are correct — fue is wrong.

worked_examples.question: Translate to Spanish: 'Next year I am going to travel to Italy because it would be exciting and I would like to visit Rome.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Next year = el año que viene. I am going to travel = voy a viajar (ir a + infinitive).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Because it would be exciting = porque sería emocionante. Sería is the conditional of ser.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: I would like to visit = me gustaría visitar. Rome = Roma.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: El año que viene voy a viajar a Italia porque sería emocionante y me gustaría visitar Roma.

bronze.question: Match the Spanish to the English meaning
Match the Spanish to the English meaning
Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: de vacaciones a España y me lo

gaps.correct_explain: fui is the yo form of ir in the preterite tense.

wrong.fue: fue is the él/ella form, not yo. First person preterite of ir = fui.
wrong.ir: ir is the infinitive. You need the preterite because el verano pasado signals a completed past action.

gaps.correct_explain: pasé is the yo preterite of pasar. The phrase is me lo pasé bien (I had a good time).

wrong.paso: paso is the present tense. Use the preterite because the time phrase is in the past.
wrong.pasó: pasó is the él/ella form. The subject is yo → pasé.

gaps.correct_explain: gustaría is the conditional of gustar. Me gustaría = I would like.

wrong.gusta: gusta is the present tense (I like). You need the conditional to say 'I would like'.
wrong.gustó: gustó is the preterite (I liked). The sentence is about a future wish.

wrong.campo: el campo means the countryside — a valid place, but the word bank here leads you to playa.

gaps.correct_explain: relajante (relaxing) is an invariable adjective — it does not change for gender.

wrong.relajar: relajar is a verb (to relax). You need an adjective after sería.

bronze.question: What does 'El año pasado fui de vacaciones a Francia' mean?
options: Last year I went on holiday to France
Next year I will go on holiday to France
I would like to go on holiday to France
I always go on holiday to France

bronze.question: What does 'Me gustaría viajar al extranjero porque sería emocionante' mean?
options: I would like to travel abroad because it would be exciting
I like travelling abroad because it is exciting
I travelled abroad because it was exciting
I am going to travel abroad because it will be exciting

bronze.source_text: El verano pasado viajé a Italia con mis amigos y me encantó.
model_answers: Last summer I travelled to Italy with my friends and I loved it.

silver.question: Complete the sentence
silver.english: Last summer I **went** to the mountains and I **swam** in the river.

gaps.correct_explain: fui is the yo form of ir in the preterite.

wrong.fue: fue is the él/ella form. The subject is yo → fui.
wrong.iba: iba is the imperfect (I used to go / was going). A completed trip takes the preterite.

gaps.correct_explain: nadé is the yo preterite of nadar: -ar regular → -é.

wrong.nado: nado is the present tense. El verano pasado requires the preterite.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: El año pasado fue de vacaciones a España con mi familia.
silver.explanation: The subject is yo (implied — 'my family' confirms I went with them). The yo form of ir in the preterite is fui, not fue (which is él/ella).
silver.translation: Last year I went on holiday to Spain with my family.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: I would like to go on holiday to Greece.

distractor_labels.gustó: wrong tense — gustó is preterite (I liked), not conditional (I would like)

silver.source_text: Last year I went to the beach and I had a good time.
model_answers: El año pasado fui a la playa y me lo pasé bien.
hints: I had a good time = me lo pasé bien

gold.source_text: Last summer I travelled to the countryside with my family. I swam in the river and I loved it. Next year I would like to visit Italy because it would be exciting.
model_answers: El verano pasado viajé al campo con mi familia. Nadé en el río y me encantó. El año que viene me gustaría visitar Italia porque sería emocionante.

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: Last year I went on holiday to the mountains and I had a great time.

distractor_labels.fue: wrong verb form — fue is él/ella, not yo
distractor_labels.la: wrong article — montañas is plural feminine, needs las not la
distractor_labels.paso: wrong tense — paso is present; el año pasado requires the preterite pasé

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a tourist information office in Spain. You are planning your holiday.

bullets.prompt: Greet the assistant and say you would like information about holidays.
bullets.model_answer: ¡Buenos días! Me gustaría información sobre vacaciones, por favor.
bullets.note: greeting + me gustaría (conditional for polite request)

bullets.prompt: Say where you went last year and give your opinion.
bullets.model_answer: El año pasado fui a la playa y me encantó porque hacía sol.
bullets.note: preterite (fui) + opinion (me encantó) + imperfect weather (hacía sol)

bullets.prompt: Say where you would like to go this summer and why.
bullets.model_answer: Este verano me gustaría ir al extranjero porque sería emocionante.

bullets.prompt: Ask how much the trip costs.
bullets.note: ¿Cuánto cuesta? — question with accent on cuánto
